components.name: Primary button
components.description: Primary button with the shared desktop, phone, focus, and reduced-motion treatment.
components.css: .ds-primary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:40px;padding:9px 16px;border-radius:var(--r-ctl, 8px);font:550 14px/1.2 var(--font-ui, "Instrument Sans", sans-serif);cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 180ms,border-color 180ms,color 180ms,transform 120ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1);background:var(--accent, #2857c7);color:var(--on-accent, #fff);border:1px solid var(--accent, #2857c7);}.ds-primary:hover{background:var(--accent-ink, #214ba9);border-color:var(--accent-ink, #214ba9);}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent, #2857c7);outline-offset:3px;}.ds-primary:active:not(:disabled){transform:scale(.975)}.ds-primary:disabled{opacity:.5;pointer-events:none}@media(max-width:640px){.ds-primary{min-height:44px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-primary{transition:none}.ds-primary:active{transform:none}}

components.name: Secondary button
components.description: Secondary button with the shared desktop, phone, focus, and reduced-motion treatment.
components.css: .ds-secondary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:40px;padding:9px 16px;border-radius:var(--r-ctl, 8px);font:550 14px/1.2 var(--font-ui, "Instrument Sans", sans-serif);cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 180ms,border-color 180ms,color 180ms,transform 120ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1);background:var(--surface, #fff);color:var(--ink, #252b2e);border:1px solid var(--line-strong, #a6afaa);}.ds-secondary:hover{border-color:var(--ink-3, #697371);}.ds-secondary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent, #2857c7);outline-offset:3px;}.ds-secondary:active:not(:disabled){transform:scale(.975)}.ds-secondary:disabled{opacity:.5;pointer-events:none}@media(max-width:640px){.ds-secondary{min-height:44px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-secondary{transition:none}.ds-secondary:active{transform:none}}

components.name: Labeled field
components.description: A native field with a persistent label and soft keyboard focus.
components.css: .ds-field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px;color:var(--ink, #252b2e);font:600 12px/1.4 var(--font-ui, "Instrument Sans", sans-serif);}.ds-input{width:100%;font:400 15px/1.4 var(--font-ui, "Instrument Sans", sans-serif);padding:9px 14px;color:var(--ink, #252b2e);background:var(--surface, #fff);border:1px solid var(--line-strong, #a6afaa);border-radius:var(--r-ctl, 8px);caret-color:var(--accent, #2857c7);}.ds-input:hover{border-color:var(--ink-3, #697371)}.ds-input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent, #2857c7);outline-offset:0;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent, #2857c7) 16%,transparent)}@media(max-width:640px){.ds-input{font-size:16px}}

components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;gap:20px;background:var(--paper, #f7f7f2);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line, #dedfd8);}.ds-nav-link{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:80px;padding:0;color:var(--ink-2, #596365);font:500 14px/1.4 var(--font-ui, "Instrument Sans", sans-serif);text-decoration:none;border-bottom:2px solid transparent;}.ds-nav-link:hover{color:var(--ink, #252b2e)}.ds-nav-link[aria-current]{color:var(--accent-ink, #214ba9);border-bottom-color:var(--accent, #2857c7);font-weight:600}.ds-nav-link:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent, #2857c7);outline-offset:3px;}

components.css: .ds-record{display:grid;grid-template-columns:138px minmax(0,1fr) 148px 72px;align-items:start;gap:24px;padding:22px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line, #dedfd8);background:transparent;color:var(--ink, #252b2e);font:400 14px/1.6 var(--font-ui, "Instrument Sans", sans-serif);}.ds-record-when{color:var(--ink-2, #596365);font-size:13px}.ds-record-link{color:var(--ink, #252b2e);font-size:15px;font-weight:600;text-decoration:none}.ds-record-link:hover{color:var(--accent-ink, #214ba9);text-decoration:underline}.ds-record-firm{display:block;color:var(--ink-2, #596365);font-size:13px}.ds-record-stage,.ds-record-remove{min-height:40px;padding:9px 8px;border:1px solid var(--line-strong, #a6afaa);border-radius:8px;color:var(--ink-2, #596365);background:var(--surface, #fff);font:500 13px/1.4 var(--font-ui, "Instrument Sans", sans-serif)}.ds-record-remove{border-color:transparent;background:transparent;cursor:pointer}.ds-record-remove:hover{border-color:var(--danger-line, #e9c8c4);color:var(--danger, #9d2b23);background:var(--danger-soft, #f7e8e6)}.ds-record-link:focus-visible,.ds-record-stage:focus-visible,.ds-record-remove:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent, #2857c7);outline-offset:3px;}@media(max-width:720px){.ds-record{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);gap:12px}}

narrative.overview:
Networkly uses the order and reading comfort of a contemporary university library catalogue. Warm neutral ground, editorial page titles, cobalt actions, and open ruled records give recruiting information a clear place. The material is digital: flat fills, real evidence, and familiar controls.

The built system gives records more space than their containers. Identity, context, timing, and actions form readable groups; supporting information sits beside the work on wide screens and follows it on phones. Forms and floating menus retain useful boundaries. Clear status wording carries meaning alongside color.
keyCharacteristics: Normal-weight serif page titles with a quiet sans-serif working hierarchy.
Warm neutral surfaces, cobalt interaction, and distinct semantic states.
Open ruled records with visible actions and restrained form enclosures.
Horizontal navigation, responsive reading order, and paired light and dark themes.

rules.name: The Semantic Color Rule
rules.body: Use cobalt for interaction. Preserve the existing domain colors and visible labels for their named states, including unknown and unverified facts.

rules.name: The Readable Label Rule
rules.body: Navigation, labels, chips, and actions use normal or sentence case without forced uppercase or tracking. Proper names, stored values, and quoted evidence preserve their original meaning.

rules.name: The Stable Surface Rule
rules.body: Record collections and page sections stay still on hover. Use color or border emphasis for interaction and reserve substantial shadow for floating content.

dos: Do use runtime CSS variables so explicit and system-selected dark themes remain paired.
Do use Fraunces for page identity and Instrument Sans for working information and controls.
Do organize records with spacing and dividers, retaining useful boundaries around forms and overlays.
Do keep role and contact actions visible, with their larger phone targets.
Do preserve native controls, keyboard focus, disclosure state, reduced motion, and persistence compatibility.
Do preserve the approved Networkly logo and explicit wording for categorical or uncertain facts.
donts: Don't reintroduce the discarded vertical navigation rail, cool blue page ground, boxed summary tiles, or page-header eyebrows.
Don't replace semantic labels with color alone or style unknown facts as confirmed outcomes.
Don't revive uppercase small labels, hover lifts, decorative page entrances, or literal paper textures.
Don't copy historical CSS fragments without checking the final page-family cascade.
Don't turn relationship categories into a numerical meter or use decorative progress to imply activity.
